3540562208.bio: "Brams" is Valencian/Catalan for "shrieks", "screams" or "yells", mostly applied to animals. The name pick might also drew upon the similarity of that word to (Johannes) Brahms. Not to be confused with Brams, a rock/ska band from Berga, Catalonia, that released several albums since the 1990s.
